diagnosis.title: ఆకు నిర్ధారణ
diagnosis.heroSubtitle: అత్యధిక ఖచ్చితత్వం కోసం ప్రభావిత ఆకును ఫ్రేమ్‌లో ఉంచండి.

assistant.title: AgroAssist AI
assistant.heroTitle: నిర్ధారణ, చికిత్స, పొల నిర్ణయాల కోసం ఆధునిక వ్యవసాయ సహాయకుడు.
assistant.heroBody: ఇటీవలి స్కాన్ ఫలితాలు, లక్షణాలు, వాతావరణ సమాచారాన్ని ఒకే సంభాషణలో ఉపయోగించండి. ఇది సాధారణ చాట్‌బాట్ కాకుండా డిజిటల్ వ్యవసాయ నిపుణుడిలా అనిపిస్తుంది.
assistant.featureDiagnosisBody: Launch a guided diagnosis conversation that narrows crop, symptoms, spread pattern, and next inspection steps.
assistant.featureDiagnosisPoint1: Checks crop and visible symptom pattern
assistant.featureDiagnosisPoint2: Suggests what to inspect in the field next
assistant.featureDiagnosisPoint3: Uses your latest scan result when available
assistant.featureDiagnosisPrompt: Start a guided diagnosis flow for my crop. Ask the most important questions step by step and help me identify the likely disease.
assistant.featureDiagnosisPromptWithScan: Use my latest diagnosis result for {{disease}} and start a guided diagnosis flow. Ask the most important follow-up questions and tell me what to inspect in the field next.
assistant.featureTreatmentBody: Generate a practical treatment plan using the latest diagnosis or your typed symptoms.
assistant.featureTreatmentPoint3: Can adapt to scan severity and crop context
assistant.featureTreatmentPrompt: Act as a treatment engine and build a practical crop treatment plan. Include immediate action, treatment options, and prevention steps.
assistant.featureTreatmentPromptWithScan: Act as a treatment engine for my latest diagnosis of {{disease}}. Give me immediate action, treatment options, and prevention steps based on that result.
assistant.featureWeatherBody: Give weather-aware field advice for irrigation timing, disease spread risk, and scouting priorities.
assistant.featureWeatherPoint1: Focuses on rain, humidity, and irrigation timing
assistant.featureWeatherPrompt: Give me weather-aware advice for my field. Include irrigation timing, disease spread risk, and a scouting checklist for the next few days.
assistant.noScanBody: మొదట పంట చిత్రాన్ని అప్‌లోడ్ చేసి, తర్వాత చికిత్స మరియు నివారణ మార్గదర్శకానికి ఇక్కడికి రండి.
assistant.inputPlaceholder: మీ పంట, లక్షణాలు, వాతావరణం లేదా చికిత్స ప్రణాళిక గురించి రాయండి...
assistant.voiceHint: వాయిస్ ఇన్‌పుట్ తదుపరి దశలో వస్తుంది. ప్రస్తుతం సహాయకుడు బహుభాషా టైప్ మార్గదర్శకాన్ని ఇస్తుంది.
assistant.settingsSavedBody: AgroAssist will use this model configuration for the next message.
assistant.settingsHint: For local demos you can connect directly to an OpenAI-compatible API or to Ollama. For production, route requests through your backend so API keys are not exposed in the browser.
assistant.settingsExamples: Quick setup: for Ollama use Base URL http://localhost:11434 and a local model like llama3.1. For an OpenAI-compatible API use a base URL such as https://api.openai.com/v1, a model like gpt-4o-mini, and your API key.
assistant.errorConfig: Model settings are incomplete. Add provider, base URL, model, and API key if required.
assistant.errorEmpty: The model returned an empty response. Try again or switch models.
assistant.errorNetwork: Could not reach the AI model. Check the URL, credentials, and CORS/network access.
assistant.setupCardTitle: AgroAssist is not connected to a model yet.
assistant.setupCardBody: Open AI Model Settings below and add either an Ollama local model or an OpenAI-compatible API before sending a message.
